junior-daily.angle: Where in the world and who is involved: leaders of four far-apart countries (US, India, Japan, Australia) meet in Manila, where the Quad began, and agree their patrol planes will fly together in 2027.

breakfast-table.angle: What it means at home: the Quad's critical minerals deals aim to keep supplies flowing so no single supplier can squeeze them, plus a push on AI, and what four countries working together means for families.

current-affairs-digest.angle: The full picture: the Manila Quad summit's outcomes item by item (minerals deals, coercion statement, 2027 patrol-aircraft exercise, AI accelerator, cables, business forum), who attended, and what comes next.
